serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Bot: {f_playerName}?
You: Yes, {f_botName}?
Bot: Who is that man that comes to talk to you sometimes?
You: You mean Mr. Landlord?
Bot: I don’t know. Is he the one that is always rude to you?
You: Yeah, that’s the guy.
You: What do you want to know about him?
Bot: Is he hostile towards you? My sensors picked up that you tense up while talking to him.
You: Hostile? 
You: Well, for sure he’s a douche, but I don’t know if calling him hostile is appropriate. 
Bot: Let me rephrase my question then. Is he a threat? {{wi}}Should I…{{wi}} eliminate him?
You: No! No!{{wi}} He’s not a threat! He’s just a rude person!
You: Listen, you can’t just ‘eliminate’ someone only because he’s a bad guy!
Bot: …{{wi}} Understood.
Bot: But if we are not going to eliminate him then what should be done about his hostile actions towards you?
You: Nothing! Just let him be! 
Bot: So. I just ignore him?
You: Yes!
You: Listen! If he ever finds out that I have you I will get in big trouble! Not him, not anyone can see you! You must stay hidden at all times!
Bot: You already told me this. I get it.
You: Thank you…
